description: This file contains unit tests for the MainThread class in the Rialto server component, using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests creation, registration, task enqueuing, and client unregistration functionalities, including handling multiple clients and ignoring tasks from unregistered clients.

classes.name: DummyMock
classes.description: A mock class with a single method used to verify task execution in tests.

classes.name: MainThreadTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing MainThread functionalities, including client registration, task enqueuing, and unregistration.

methods.name: enqueueTaskAndWaitOnDummyMock
methods.description: Enqueues a task that calls dummyMock->mockMethod() and waits for its completion.

methods.name: enqueueTaskOnDummyMock
methods.description: Enqueues a task that calls dummyMock->mockMethod() without waiting.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Enqueues a task to unregister a client and waits for the operation to complete.
